quote: ‘Now I’ve got everything,’ Moomintroll said to himself. ‘I’ve got the whole year. Winter too. I’m the first Moomin to have lived through an entire year.’
source: Tove Jansson, Moominland Midwinter, chapter 6, The First of Spring (Moomintroll) (trans. Thomas Warburton, 1958)
speaker: Moomintroll
